title: Number Of Valid Words For Each Puzzle
description: For each puzzle, count words that contain the first letter of the puzzle and consist only of characters present in the puzzle.
pseudocode:
1. freqMap = {}
2. For each word in words: mask = bitmask(word), freqMap[mask]++
3. For each puzzle in puzzles:
4.   firstBit = 1 << (puzzle[0] - 'a')
5.   submask = (all bits of puzzle except first)
6.   iterate all subsets of submask, add freqMap[subset | firstBit]

steps.note: Initialize freqMap with word masks. 'apple' -> {a, p, l, e} -> mask.
Identify the mandatory first bit for the current puzzle.
Iterate through subsets of the puzzle mask to find matching word counts.
